about: Fresh test set for the workshop fine-tune, written by hand for this workshop (2026-11-20), separately from the training templates. Each label follows from the stated facts. The ticket group uses the four training teams with different option wording; hr, shop and city are domains the model never sees in training. Small and synthetic: use it to compare models, not to predict production accuracy.

ticket.question: Which team should handle this ticket?

choices.account: sign-in, passwords, 2FA, users, roles and workspace membership
choices.billing: charges, invoices, refunds, prices and plans
choices.bug: the product does not work the way it should
choices.feature request: asking for something the product does not do yet

hr.question: Which HR team should handle this message?

choices.benefits: health insurance, pension, gym and other employee benefits
choices.leave: holidays, sick leave, parental leave and time-off balances
choices.payroll: salary, payslips, tax deductions, bonuses and expense reimbursements
choices.recruiting: job openings, interviews, referrals and new hires

shop.question: Which queue should this customer message go to?

choices.delivery: where an order is, late or lost parcels, delivery address
choices.payments: declined cards, double charges, vouchers and payment methods
choices.product questions: sizes, materials, compatibility and how a product works
choices.returns: sending items back, exchanges and refunds for returned goods

city.question: Which city department should handle this report?

choices.parks: public parks, playgrounds, trees and green spaces
choices.roads: potholes, street lights, traffic signs and road damage
choices.waste: rubbish collection, recycling, bulky waste and litter
